statement: Serre’s intersection-multiplicity conjecture. Proves strict positivity of Serre's intersection multiplicity $`\chi^R(M,N)`$ for nonzero finitely generated modules over any regular local ring, provided $`M\otimes_R N`$ has finite length and $`\dim M+\dim N=\dim R`$. This resolves the positivity conjecture, including ramified mixed characteristic.
